In the moody and modern interiors of our restaurant, we serve various specialties of European cuisine. Our chefs make sure that every meal is not only tasty, but also healthy and exquisite served. We guarantee that our dishes will satisfy even the most demanding gourmets.

	We also took care of the cozy and comfortable decor of our restaurant. Fresh compositions of flowers that always host our tables, a beautiful view of the surrounding nature, playing lights in the evening - all this makes our guests enjoy delicious dishes in a unique atmosphere.

	We invite you every day from 15:00 to 21:00

Nowhere in the area you can taste such a well -prepared espresso based on aromatic, freshly ground Arabica and Robusta grains. Regardless of whether you prefer strong, black coffee, delicate cappucino or velvet flavored latte, every coffee connoisseur will definitely find something for themselves in our diverse menu.

	Of course, we recommend delicious desserts for coffee, especially ice cups prepared using liquid nitrogen.

	After a day full of impressions, you can also relax with the original drink or lamp of excellent wine.

	All this is waiting for you every day from 12 to 23.
